capabilities: Define components as Markdown notes with front-matter default values
Update every note using a component when its definition is edited
Render multi-line output delimited by HTML comment syntax
disambiguation: Not UI components; a component is a plain Markdown note whose rendered output is written into the note as ordinary Markdown.
problem: Obsidian's Templates insert static content only; there is no way to parameterize a reusable Markdown block and keep every instance in sync when the definition changes.

relations.evidence: Raindown does everything Components does and more, so Components turns itself off when Raindown's enabled.

summary: Markdown-based reusable components: define a template note once, pass arguments per note, and edits propagate everywhere it is used.
